sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [DATATYPE] MainShape / sh:sparql / FILTER datatype checks for ?nearestValue, ?nearbyValue, and ?recordedValue: The constraint only accepts numericValue literals whose datatype is exactly xsd:decimal. The requirement specifies numeric distances and concentration, not decimal-only values, so valid QuantityValue data using xsd:integer or another supported numeric XSD datatype would incorrectly violate the constraint. Required change: Replace the exact xsd:decimal datatype tests with numeric-compatible validation that accepts the supported numeric literal datatypes while retaining the required comparisons.
